description: This file defines the Amxrt class providing an interface to the Ambiorix runtime, including initialization, configuration, connection, event loop control, and data model management.

classes.name: Amxrt
classes.description: A class providing an interface to initialize, configure, connect, and control the Ambiorix runtime environment.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the runtime configuration with command line arguments and an optional handler.

methods.name: LoadOdlFiles
methods.description: Loads ODL files specified on the command line or the default odl file.

methods.name: AddAutoSave
methods.description: Adds an entry point function to the parser.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Connects to all bus sockets, including auto-detected ones.

methods.name: ConfigScanBackendDirs
methods.description: Scans backend directories for available backends.

methods.name: EnableSyssigs
methods.description: Enables system signals to be monitored by the event loop.

methods.name: RegisterOrWait
methods.description: Registers the data model or waits for required data model objects.

methods.name: RunEventLoop
methods.description: Starts the event loop, blocking until it is stopped.

methods.name: getDatamodel
methods.description: Returns the runtime data model storage.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration options as an htable variant.
